title: Independent CPU verification of Holo HRR attention at T=512
hypothesis: The public Holo HRR repository can complete its published T=512 three-arm training comparison on the public enwik8 corpus under a frozen CPU lab run.
rationale: The upstream T=512 report uses a local Telegram corpus and MPS measurements that are not present in the public checkout. This experiment independently verifies the executable implementation and comparison protocol on the public enwik8 artifact while explicitly classifying the result as corpus-proxy evidence. Revision v2 records distinct model references for proposer and engineering reviewer after the admission gate rejected the first contract's role identity collision.
